rows.grounds: numeral indicating the eight supernatural powers
compound with internal sandhi: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulaṃ; equates attainment of siddhis with the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula practice for attaining the eight supernatural powers?
premises: The eight supernatural powers are included among the accomplishments described.
The attainment of these supernatural powers is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: Attaining the eight supernatural powers is therefore an expression of the root Kaula practice.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight siddhis is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And, O fair-faced one, the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula.
